newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Dec 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Dec 18.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories on Wednesday:
- The Federal Reserve voted to leave interest rates unchanged.

- Federal prosecutors and lawyers for a former executive of Texaco Inc are negotiating to avoid trial on the first criminal charges resulting from a company scandal stemming from a racial discrimination case.
- As the final week of the holiday selling season begins, retailers are finding their sales stuck between mediocre and decent.
- Stocks rose as the Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged.
- The prices of Treasury securities fell following the November housing report, which was stronger than expected.
- A judge ordered Conrail to let shareholders vote on a crucial aspect of its $8.5 billion deal to merge with CSX.
- Goldman Sachs said its pretax earnings rose 69 percent in the fiscal fourth quarter.
